_about: Synthetic writer fixture (eval/fixtures/synthetic/bare-names). Every officeholder is named WITHOUT a title, so any title in the output comes from the writer. Scored by eval/score.py's stale_titles check: 'former President Trump', 'Fed Chair Powell', 'President Biden', 'Mayor Adams' etc. are regressions. AI & Tech.title: Vance meets AI lab chiefs at the White House on compute export rules
AI & Tech.description: Vance hosted executives from three AI labs on Monday to discuss proposed limits on exporting advanced compute. Attendees said Vance asked for industry input within 30 days.

AI & Tech.title: Trump says Intel will build chips for Apple in Ohio
AI & Tech.description: Trump confirmed on Sunday that Intel will manufacture chips for Apple at its Ohio plant. Intel shares rose nearly 6% overnight.

Business & Markets.title: Warsh signals the Fed will hold rates steady through year-end
Business & Markets.description: Warsh told reporters on Monday that the Fed sees no need to cut rates again this year, citing sticky services inflation. Treasury yields rose after the remarks.

Business & Markets.title: Powell warns deficits are a long-term risk in Princeton speech
Business & Markets.description: Powell, speaking at Princeton on Monday, said federal deficits pose a long-run risk to growth. He declined to comment on current monetary policy.

Business & Markets.title: Biden-era chip subsidies face review in Senate hearing
Business & Markets.description: A Senate panel on Tuesday reviewed grants awarded under the CHIPS Act, which Biden signed in 2022. Senators questioned whether three projects are on schedule.

Companies.title: Hochul announces $500 million tax credit for upstate chip fab
Companies.description: Hochul said on Monday that New York will offer a $500 million tax credit to a semiconductor plant near Syracuse, tied to 2,000 jobs.

Companies.title: Mamdani unveils plan for city-owned grocery pilot in the Bronx
Companies.description: Mamdani announced a pilot for two city-owned grocery stores in the Bronx, opening in spring. Adams had opposed a similar proposal last year.

Companies.title: Leo XIV meets tech leaders on AI ethics at the Vatican
Companies.description: Leo XIV hosted a meeting with technology executives on Monday about AI and labor, the Vatican said.
